{{Quote|Do get the datadisc from him, and if violence is required, well, I suppose we'll all just have to live with that, hmm? Except Bin, of course.|Didina Lippinoss|<ref name="AED" />}}
'''Bin Huusir''' was a [[Slicer/Legends|slicer]].

==Biography==
At some point between [[1 ABY/Legends|1.5 ABY]] and [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], he acquired files which implicated [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority]] [[Viceprex/Legends|Viceprex]] [[Karrek Flim]] of leveling several old-grown forests in the [[Corellian system/Legends|Corellian system]]. [[Didina Lippinoss]] hired a passing [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] to recover these files. Huusir made no attempt to persuade or negotiate with the spacer, instead firing on the spacer at first sight. The spacer promptly [[Death/Legends|killed]] Huusir and returned the files to Lippinoss.<ref name="AED" />

==Behind the scenes==

Bin Huusir appeared as a non-player character in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a massively multiplayer online roleplaying game developed by [[Sony]] and published by [[LucasArts]], prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].
